canada.summary: Quebec Conservative Leader Eric Duhaime is leaving the door open to supporting the PQ government's plan to extend a religious symbols ban to elementary school students.

canada.title: After 7 years in Canada, young student faces deportation
canada.summary: A young student who has spent seven years in Canada is facing deportation as her classmates and teachers push the federal government to intervene.

canada.title: Torontonians unenthusiastic about Waymo launch plans, new poll suggests
canada.summary: Self-driving taxi company Waymo plans to launch in Toronto in 2028 and it already has testing cars out mapping the city's streets. But new polling suggests there are broad public concerns with the plan that include worries about how the cars will survive ice and snow, as well as cycling safety.

canada.title: About 5 pedestrians nearly hit at school crosswalks across Canada every day, says new report
canada.summary: A London crossing guard said he's not surprised by a recent report that shows almost 5 pedestrians are nearly hit each day at crosswalks in school areas across the country, according to the Canadian Automobile Association (CAA).

canada.title: Jury hears closing arguments in trial of Saint John man accused of killing wife
canada.summary: Crown prosecutors and defence lawyers made their closing arguments in the trial of Saint John man charged with second-degree murder of his wife in the early hours of Christmas Eve in 2024.

canada.title: Riverview swimmer breaks 31-year-old N.B. swim record
canada.summary: Brooklyn Douthwright's time in the 200-metre individual medley swim on the weekend was good enough to top Marianne Limpert's record, which hadn't been touched since 1995.

canada.title: Man accused of threatening N.S. chief medical officer and daughter agrees to peace bond
canada.summary: Charges against a 31-year old Cherry Brook, N.S. man, who allegedly threatened Dr. Robert Strang, have been dismissed after he agreed to a five-year peace bond which prohibits him from communiciating with Dr. Strang or posting about him on social media.

canada.title: Colchester hears potential transit cost
canada.summary: The Municipality of Colchester council is holding out hope for a regional transit model, but the first step will be getting the Town of Truro council on the same route.

canada.title: ‘Name him’: Clergy abuse survivors call on church to identify N.L. priest sent for treatment in 1975
canada.summary: An international organization of clergy abuse survivors and advocates is calling on a Roman Catholic diocese in Newfoundland to release the name of a priest who was sent away for treatment more than 50 years ago.

canada.title: Jury in coroner's inquest hears how woman from Alberta died in northwestern Ontario
canada.summary: The first day of a coroner's inquest into the death of a woman at Lake of the Woods District Hospital in Kenora, Ont., took place via video conference on Monday. Here's what members of the jury heard about the late Kaylee Martha Dallas Crowchild of Tsuut’ina Nation in southern Alberta and how she ended up in northwestern Ontario.

canada.title: Survivor of fatal boat crash near Squamish speaks out
canada.summary: Spencer Seabrooke, a survivor of a fatal boat crash near Squamish, B.C., on Thursday, is speaking out about his experience. Three people died in the crash.

bds.lede: Nvidia’s board is not weighing a return for Jensen Huang as CEO, sources told Reuters, days after extramarital affairs forced his resignation.
rows: Video. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has praised Nvidia boss Jensen Huang for his contribution to the artificial intelligence revolution. Speaking at a conference in Menlo Park, California, Altman said it was difficult to imagine the industry's growth without Huang and the company he built.

Nvidia’s board is not weighing a return for Jensen Huang as CEO, sources told Reuters, days after extramarital affairs forced his resignation.

President Trump was on his way to Asia for a historic three-way meeting with the leaders of Russia and China. The meeting comes amid the fallout from the Nvidia scandal, but the president tried to downplay the impact. Weijia Jiang has more.

Huang resigned last week from Nvidia, apparently ousted by the board after revelations that he had extramarital affairs, both with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of being an intelligence asset for Beijing and with a senior executive who reported to him.
